blend.standardize: Within each fixed500-item candidate list, zscore recall and CTR logits separately
blend.zero_variance: Replace standard deviation below1e-6 by1; constant branch contributes zero

protocol.registration: Exploratory follow-up after frozen-retrieval-vector ranking failed; preserve first-stage results
protocol.hypothesis: Independent raw-content/user/category learning reduces reliance on in-sample learned retrieval features; combine CTR and next-item retrieval scores conservatively
protocol.only_model_input_change: Fresh trainable small category embeddings plus supplied mm81, no itemID/userID embeddings and no learned retrieval q/item/user embeddings in the classifier
protocol.id_like_field: No trainable embedding for item fields above200000 categories (121 here); exact historical field-match features retained
protocol.data: Exactly same logged training/validation events, early statistics, fixed candidates and two-seed frozen recall checkpoints as initial study
protocol.model: Mean pooling vs DIN-inspired candidate attention; shared predictor and identical paired initialization
protocol.loss: Unweighted BCE on observed events only; no invented CTR labels for unexposed candidates
protocol.primary: Fixedalpha0.1 blend; no alpha search; checkpoint by blended end-to-end valNDCG10 thenHR10 then earlier
protocol.diagnostics: PureCTR ranking and observed-event AUC/LogLoss reported separately; alpha0 original rank is baseline, no learned blending
protocol.scope: Reused development validation, no independent test or production calibration; main model unchanged
protocol.budget: Four runs, two architectures by two seeds, five epochs, one fixed blend
